item.title: Maryland’s slowed economic growth likely due to federal layoffs, labor market decline
item.description: Federal jobs in Maryland decreased by about 9 percent from January 2025 to September 2025.

item.title: Maryland women’s basketball’s in-game arena host built a career off her passion
item.description: JayCee Ruffin has become a familiar voice for Terps fans with her consistent energy.

item.title: A challenging season set up Josephine Kogler’s return to form with Maryland gymnastics
item.description: Kogler was dealing with mental block, a prevalent issue in gymnastics that prevented her from performing on previously mastered skills.

item.title: UMD community members hold vigil to honor ICE shooting victims, call for change
item.description: This university’s Young Democratic Socialists of America chapter hosted a vigil to mourn people who have been killed by immigration enforcement officers.

item.title: College Park City Council restricts how early landlords can ask tenants to renew leases
item.description: Under the new policy, landlords may not offer a lease renewal earlier than 180 days from the end of the tenant’s current lease.

item.title: If a class requires you to leave UMD, transportation should be guaranteed
item.description: If a student’s grade will be affected by their ability to make it off-campus, students need transportation to create an equitable environment for students.

item.title: No. 22 Maryland women’s basketball snaps 4-game losing streak with 86-70 win over No. 12 Michigan State
item.description: The Terps' 86-point total, backed by 32 made field goals, marked its most points in a game since Jan. 11.

item.title: Prince George’s County Council member Wala Blegay is running for Congress
item.description: Maryland’s 5th District is set to open when Democratic Rep. Steny Hoyer retires at the end of this year.

item.title: No. 7 Maryland women’s lacrosse looks to return to glory after years of heartbreak
item.description: In four of the Terps’ past five years, their season ended in NCAA tournament games that were decided by a goal.

item.title: Here are some resources for navigating ICE encounters on campus
